evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Delivered as a constitutive operational creed — an identity-level rule equating rehearsal with possession — not merely a settled decision but a bedrock principle the speaker treats as definitional.
A ratified cadence recorded as settled and load-bearing — the document performs the settling by recording the operational schedule.
Assignment of ownership ratifies the decision — the document performs the settling by recording who is accountable.

mints.name: UnrehearsedMeansUnowned
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here asserting that a capability is not real until it has been rehearsed — equating practice with possession?
